categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Has the Wallet label and modifies SQLite wallet storage and schema migration logic across src/wallet/.
categories.rationale: Migrating SQLite transaction storage from generic key-value records to a dedicated relational table eliminates composite serialization and fixes out-of-order record loading that complicates wallet logic. It represents a substantial architectural improvement to wallet database maintenance and unblocks #27865.
